title: Reindeer Freeze
instructions: Shoes or bare feet, no socks. Stand by a chair, lift one foot, antler hands on head, FREEZE! The room may heckle (no touching). Grab the chair, foot down or antlers drop: you're out!
props: a sturdy chair each (grab it if you wobble, no shame!)
winner: First to grab the chair, put their foot down or drop their antlers loses; both still frozen at the buzzer = Tie. Heckling only, never touching.

title: Name That Elf
instructions: Take turns naming Christmas movies or TV specials, one each, back and forth. Challenged player starts. No repeats! Blank for 5 seconds or repeat a title and you're out.
winner: First to repeat a title, name something that isn't a Christmas movie or special, or go 5 seconds without answering loses; the host is final judge of what counts (Die Hard debates welcome); both still going at the buzzer = Tie.

title: Over-the-Shoulder Snowballs
instructions: Stand behind the line with your back to your mug. Toss 5 paper snowballs over your shoulder, one at a time. No fetching! Most in your mug wins.
props: a mug each (on the floor, about 1 m / 3 ft behind the line, away from candles)
a throw line (rug edge or a shoe)
winner: At the buzzer, count the snowballs inside each mug (bounce-ins count, fetched ones don't); most wins; same number = Tie.

title: Toothless Turkey
instructions: Fold your lips over your teeth. Take turns telling each other your Christmas wish list. Challenged player starts. Try to make your rival laugh! Flash a single tooth and you're out.
winner: First to flash a tooth loses; the host decides (the room may point); no teeth seen by the buzzer = Tie. Dentures or missing teeth? The player may ask the host to re-roll.

title: Find the Pudding Coin
instructions: The host hides a coin under one of 3 upside-down mugs and shuffles. On 'Point!', both point at once. Right = 1 point. Both right? Faster shuffle! First to 3 wins.
winner: The host (or a player from a team not in the Showdown) shuffles, calls 'Point!' and lifts the right mug; each player pointing at it on the call scores 1 (late points don't count); first to 3 wins; both reach 3 together, or level at the buzzer = Tie.

title: Cushion Crown
instructions: Sit or stand. Balance a cushion on your head, hands by your sides, and sing 'Jingle Bells' on a loop, nodding on every 'jingle'. Drop it, touch it or stop singing and you're out!
props: 2 matching small cushions (or 2 folded tea towels or 2 paperbacks)
winner: First to drop or touch their cushion, or stop singing, loses; both crowns still on at the buzzer = Tie.

title: Santa, Reindeer, Snowman
instructions: Christmas rock-paper-scissors! On 'Ho, ho, HO!' pose: Santa (belly), Reindeer (antlers) or Snowman (stiff arms). Santa rides Reindeer, Reindeer tramples Snowman, Snowman freezes Santa. First to 3!
winner: The host calls 'Ho, ho, HO!' and both pose on the last HO (a late pose loses the round; same pose = go again); Santa beats Reindeer, Reindeer beats Snowman, Snowman beats Santa; first to 3 wins; level at the buzzer = Tie.

title: Carol Ping-Pong
instructions: Take turns SINGING a line from a different Christmas song. Any tune counts, however wobbly! Challenged player starts. Repeat a song or stall 5 seconds and you're out.
winner: First to repeat a song or stall 5 seconds loses; the host decides what counts as a Christmas song (winter songs like 'Let It Snow' are allowed); both still singing at the buzzer = Tie.

title: Magnificent Moustache
instructions: Tuck a pen (cap on) between your top lip and nose: a festive moustache! No hands. Every time the host claps, both say 'Bring us some figgy pudding!' First pen down loses.
winner: The host claps about every 3 seconds; first whose pen drops (or who touches it) loses; both moustaches still on at the buzzer = Tie.

title: No Yes, No No
instructions: Fire quick questions at each other: answer, then ask one back. Challenged player asks first. NEVER say 'yes' or 'no'; nods and head-shakes count too! Slip or stall 3 seconds: out!
winner: First to say yes or no (yeah, yep and nope count), nod, shake their head or stall 3 seconds loses; the host may throw in a question and keeps them family-friendly; both clean at the buzzer = Tie.

title: Snowball Blow-Off
instructions: Sit opposite each other across a table, hands behind your back. Host drops the paper snowball in the middle: blow it off your rival's edge. Stay seated! First to 2 goals wins.
props: a cleared table or coffee table
winner: Ball off a player's edge = a goal to the other player; after a goal, or if it goes off the side, the host puts it back in the middle; first to 2 goals, or most at the buzzer, wins; level = Tie.

title: Duet Disaster
instructions: Sing 'Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer' ONE word each, back and forth, one word per clap as the room claps a steady beat. Challenged player starts. Miss the beat, sing two or slip a lyric: out!
winner: Whoever's word misses the clap, or who sings two words or a wrong lyric, loses; the host is the judge; both on the beat at the buzzer = Tie.

title: Frosty Stare-Down
instructions: Face each other and lock eyes. The room may heckle and pull faces from behind your rival (no touching!). First to blink or look away loses.
winner: A spotter from a team not in the Showdown watches each player's eyes (the host does it if there are only two teams); first blink or look-away loses; the host has the final say; both unblinking at the buzzer = Tie. Contact lenses or dry eyes? Re-roll the player.

title: Jingle Buzz
instructions: On the room's steady clap, count from 1, one number each, challenged player first. Say 'Jingle' for 3, 6, 9…, 'Bells' for 5, 10…, 'Jingle Bells' for 15, 30… Miss a beat or slip: out!
winner: First to miss the beat or say the wrong word or number loses (multiples of 3 = Jingle, of 5 = Bells, of both = Jingle Bells); both perfect at the buzzer = Tie.

title: Snowball Spoon
instructions: Shoes or bare feet, no socks. Hold a spoon by the very end of its handle, paper snowball in the bowl. Follow the host's calls: 'Turn!' 'Sit!' 'Stand!' 'Bow!' Snowball drops: you're out!
props: a chair each, backed against a wall
winner: The host calls a move every 3-4 seconds at a steady, never frantic pace until the buzzer; first snowball to fall (or be steadied with the other hand) loses; both still balanced at the buzzer = Tie.

title: Santa's Body Clock
instructions: Backs to the TV, eyes closed. When the host says GO, count silently and raise a hand when you think exactly 15 seconds have passed. Room: not a peep!
winner: The host says GO as the timer starts and reads the timer at each raised hand (15 s gone = 15 left on the 30 s timer); closest to 15 wins; equally close = Tie.

title: Copycat Elf
instructions: Take turns, challenged player first: copy every move so far in order, then add one new festive move (antler hands, sleigh-bell shake, jolly belly laugh…). Forget or muddle one: out! No jumping or spinning.
winner: First to miss a move, get the order wrong or stall 5 seconds loses; the host is the final judge; both perfect at the buzzer = Tie.

title: Cup Flip
instructions: Stand a paper or plastic cup mouth-up, hanging half over the table edge. Flick it up so it flips and lands upside down. Land it, reset, go again. First to 3 wins!
props: a paper or plastic cup each (not glass)
winner: The room counts clean landings aloud (the host has the final say); first to 3 wins, otherwise most at the buzzer; level = Tie.

title: Santa Pat-and-Rub
instructions: Sit or stand. Pat your head with one hand and rub your belly in circles with the other. Every time the host claps, swap hands! Both patting or both rubbing? You're out!
winner: The host claps every 3-4 seconds, faster near the end; first to pat or rub with both hands, or freeze for 2 seconds, loses; both clean at the buzzer = Tie.

title: Sleigh Test Flight
instructions: Fold a paper sleigh (any paper plane, must have wings) before the buzzer. Then both launch together from the same line on the host's count. Everyone else stays behind you! Farthest flight wins.
props: a launch line facing a clear wall or hallway (away from candles, the tree and drinks)
winner: At the buzzer, the host counts '3, 2, 1, fly!' and both launch from the line; the plane that ends up farthest from the line wins (a crumpled ball or wingless entry can't win); too close to call = Tie.
